{{Quote|Star Destroyer, this is Sayer Mon Neela of the Rebel Alliance. I order you to surrender your vessel.|[[Sayer Mon Neela]], to the ''[[Imperial Hazard]]''|<ref name="TCoIH" />}}
Circa [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was forced to '''evacuate''' its research base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Horob]] after it was uncovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="TCoIH" />

[[File:NeelaAndStasheffEscape-AJ10.jpg|thumb|left|170px|[[Sayer Mon Neela]] & [[Raan Stasheff]] escape hostile [[Horobian]]s.]]

[[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Imperial Hazard]]'' was dispatched to destroy the weakly defended Rebel base. Rebel leader and strategist [[Sayer Mon Neela]] was ordered to evacuate first but refused to abandon the doomed base. She ordered her ship, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Heedon]]'s [[Luxury yacht/Legends|Luxury yacht]] ''[[Starcrossed]]'', to head to the Imperial Star Destroyer and she ordered the ''Imperial Hazard'' to surrender. Intrigued and beguiled by the strong-willed woman, Imperial Captain [[Sergus Lanox]] accepted to meet her aboard his ship. Using a experimental technology device designed on Horob, Neela managed to disrupt the computer systems of the Destroyer. The ''Imperial Hazard'' started to lose altitude, dragging ''Starcrossed'' with it as they were connected by an umbilical corridor. Soon Lanox ordered his stormtroopers to boad the yacht and a [[Lightfight|firefight]] erupted in the umbilical. Stasheff was injured but the stormtroopers retreated in the Destroyer due to the depressurizing corridor. Neela escaped the Star Destroyer in the confusion, surprisingly assisted by Lanox, who snatched a quick kiss from her before she departed. With the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] stunned, the ''Starcrossed'' easily escaped through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to [[Carosi XII]]. Sayer Mon Neela's mission aboard the ''Imperial Hazard'' allowed the Rebels on Horob to evacuate successfully.<ref name="TCoIH" />

Following the battle, Lanox was awarded the [[Distinguished Medal of Imperial Honor/Legends|Distinguished Medal of Imperial Honor]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Miltin Takel]] himself.
